name: Heat conduction
description: Calculates the rate of heat conduction (H_cond) using thermal conductivity (κ), cross-sectional area (A), temperature difference (T_2 - T_1), and length or thickness (l).

name: Heat Convection
description: Calculates the rate of heat convection (H_conv) using heat convection constant (q), surface area (A), and temperature difference (T_2 - T_1).

name: Heat Radiation
description: Calculates the rate of heat radiation (H_rad) using emissivity (e), Stefan's constant (σ), surface area (A), and absolute temperature (T).

name: Stefan - Boltzmann's Law
description: The total emissive power of a black body (ε_o) is equal to Stefan's constant (σ) times the fourth power of absolute temperature (T).

name: Emissivity
description: Emissivity (e) is the ratio of the total emissive power of an object (ε) to the total emissive power of a blackbody (ε_o).

name: First Law of Thermodynamics
description: The change in internal energy (ΔU) is equal to net heat flow (Q) minus total work (W) done by the system.

name: Internal Energy
description: Calculates internal energy (U) using the number of moles (n), universal gas constant (R), and absolute temperature (T). Can also be calculated using number of particles and Boltzmann constant.

name: Thermal efficiency
description: Thermal efficiency (η) is the ratio of work output (W) to heat input (Q_H).

name: Carnot's Theorem (Maximum Efficiency)
description: Calculates maximum efficiency (η_c) using the absolute temperature of the cold reservoir (T_C) and absolute temperature of the hot reservoir (T_H).
